title: Yo soy Betty, la fea

ai_content.desc_en: Yo soy Betty, la fea is a popular soap opera, a comedy-drama series that follows the story of Beatriz Pinzn Solano, a brilliant economist with a master's degree in finance, who has one flaw: her looks.
